title: Director Enterprise/Lead-Solution Architect - AI/GEN AI (22+ yrs)
jobDescription:
Experience Range (only)-23-29 yrs


Solution Architect/Enterprise Architect

Location: India
Company: EPAM Systems

About EPAM

EPAM is a leading global provider of digital transformation services, consulting, and engineering solutions. We work with Fortune 500 companies and global enterprises to deliver next-generation platforms and managed services. We are seeking a Lead Solution Architect (Director-level) who combines deep technical knowledge, leadership of large-scale managed services programs, and the ability to engage senior business stakeholders.

This role is ideal for a strategic thinker and hands-on technologist who can inspire teams, shape enterprise architectures, and drive business outcomes in complex global delivery environments.

Role Overview

As a Lead Enterprise/Solution Architect at EPAM, you will play a dual role as a technology leader and client partner. You will lead solution strategy, oversee architecture governance, and manage large-scale managed services engagements. You will directly interact with CXO-level stakeholders to define transformation roadmaps while guiding and mentoring teams of architects and engineers to deliver excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Enterprise Architecture & Strategy
    • Define and own the solution strategy for large-scale digital transformation and managed services programs.
    • Drive multi-year technology roadmaps, modern platform architectures, and operating models.
    • Ensure solutions are scalable, resilient, cost-efficient, and aligned with business objectives.
  • Managed Services Leadership
    • Architect and oversee large-scale managed services engagements, including application management, cloud operations, and platform engineering.
    • Define SLAs, governance models, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement frameworks.
    • Ensure operational excellence through automation, AI/GenAI, and DevOps-driven practices.
  • Hands-On Technical Leadership
    • Stay hands-on with architecture, proof-of-concepts, and technology exploration.
    • Lead technical due diligence, solution assessments, and modernization strategies.
    • Advocate for innovation, including cloud-native, microservices, event-driven architectures, and AI/GenAI-enabled solutions.
  • Client Advisory & Stakeholder Engagement
    • Act as a trusted advisor to CIOs, CTOs, and other CXO-level executives.
    • Bridge business strategy with technology execution, presenting clear roadmaps and business cases.
    • Lead pre-sales, RFP/RFI responses, and executive-level presentations to secure new business opportunities.
  • Team Leadership & Talent Development
    • Lead a community of solution architects, principal engineers, and delivery leads across multiple geographies.
    • Foster a culture of technical excellence, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.
    • Mentor senior architects on architecture best practices, client engagement, and managed services solutioning.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 23+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise architecture, and solution design.
  • Proven track record in leading large-scale managed services programs (multi-year, multi-million-dollar engagements).
  • Deep knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), enterprise integration, and platform modernization.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one programming language (Java, .NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Python).
  • Strong expertise in service delivery models, SLAs/KPIs, and governance frameworks.
  • Experience with AI/GenAI integration in managed services (automation, predictive analytics, conversational AI, knowledge management).
  • Demonstrated ability to interact with and influence CXO-level executives.
  • Proven experience in IT consulting or global delivery organizations.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and presentation skills.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with AIOps, MLOps, and intelligent automation.
  • Knowledge of GenAI orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock).
  • Strong business acumen to participate in contract negotiations, service pricing, and P&L discussions.
  • Thought leadership (public speaking, whitepapers, or blogs in architecture and AI/GenAI).

Why EPAM?

  • Lead strategic client partnerships at the intersection of technology, business, and operations.
  • Influence technology direction for some of the worlds largest enterprises.
  • Drive large-scale, multi-tower managed services programs with cutting-edge automation and GenAI.
  • Join a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous growth.

About AIONOS

AIONOS (pronounced aye-yo-nos) is an AI-native technology company that builds and operates enterprise AI for industries. Founded in 2024 and headquartered in Singapore, AIONOS is a joint venture between InterGlobe Enterprises and Assago Group, bringing together deep enterprise technology expertise and sector-defining operational experience. With live operations across the USA, UK, Europe, the Middle East, Japan, APAC, ANZ, and India, the company deploys a workforce of 2,500+ AI engineers, domain specialists, and practitioners across Aviation, Travel & Hospitality, Logistics, Telecom, BFSI, and Healthcare. Powered by its proprietary AI enterprise stack, AIONOS delivers measurable business outcomes through an accountable, human-in-the-loop model that sits on top of existing enterprise investments.


For more information, visit www.aionos.ai


Job Summary

Own origination, pipeline, and revenue across Global Capability Centers. You bring your own accounts, we add a named list, and you run pursuits end to end while advising clients on setting up, scaling, and transforming their GCCs. You will sell AIONOS's full service line: Strategy, Consulting, Technology, Data and AI, Cloud, SAP, Security.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own revenue for your accounts. Build qualified pipeline and grow wallet share.
  • Carry and deliver the number. Inside sales supports the top of the funnel, but attainment sits with you. Set account priorities, brief the inside sales executives, and source your own meetings where coverage falls short.
  • Run large pursuits spanning multiple service lines, from qualification through commercial negotiation and closure.
  • Map GCCs to their US parent companies to find warm entry points.
  • Represent AIONOS at GCC forums, industry events, and client roundtables, and feed market and competitive intelligence back into growth strategy.
  • Work across Client Groups, Industry teams, and Global Sales on integrated account strategies.

Must Have Skills

Experience

  • 7 to 10 years of enterprise technology consulting or sales experience, selling Digital, Cloud, Data and AI, or large transformation programmes into Travel, Transport, Logistics, BFSI, or Telecom clients.
  • A live rolodex inside existing GCCs in these verticals. You should be able to open doors in weeks, not quarters.
  • Deals run end to end: account mining, pipeline creation, CXO relationships, commercial negotiation.

Hunting and demand generation

  • Hardcore outbound to US and India enterprise buyers, including cold outreach and meetings you sourced yourself. Be ready to walk us through your prospecting method and how many connects became meetings.
  • Able to direct inside sales effort with sharp targeting, clear messaging, and tight follow up, while still picking up the phone yourself.
  • A quota you have carried and hit. Bring the target, the achievement, the percentage, and the period for your last two or three cycles. We will ask.

Thinking and initiative

  • Finds ways into accounts that others miss, and builds an offer around the client's real problem instead of a standard service pitch.
  • Works without being managed. Reads account data, org charts, and market signals to decide where to spend time, then tells a story good enough to get a meeting. We are screening for initiative and follow through, not credentials.

Travel

  • Roughly half the year in the US, on a cycle of 15 days in India followed by 15 days in the US. Valid passport required, US visa preferred.

Good to Have

  • Background at a Tier 1 consulting or systems integration firm.
  • Existing relationships with NASSCOM chapter heads or the GCC Council.
  • Experience managing strategic global accounts and complex pursuits with many stakeholders.
  • Sales certification covering the full sales motion from prospecting to closing. Salesforce Certified Agentforce Sales Foundations preferred. HubSpot Academy or LinkedIn Learning equivalents also relevant.

Education

Bachelor's degree required. MBA or PGDM from a premier institute preferred.

Job Summary

Here at Appian, our values of Intensity and Excellence define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.

Our Engineering team is revolutionizing how Appian resolves customer issues by building AI-powered diagnostic tools and internal platforms that dramatically reduce resolution time. We combine deep technical expertise with AI innovation to empower support engineers to identify root causes faster, ensuring our customers experience uninterrupted business-critical operations. This team operates with high autonomy and directly impacts customer satisfaction and retention across Appians enterprise client base.

The Opportunity: Appian is at an inflection point where intelligent automation meets customer success, and we need a technical leader who can architect and ship the next generation of diagnostic platforms. This role exists because our growing enterprise customer base demands faster, smarter issue resolution, and AI agents are the key to unlocking that scale. You will shape both the technical direction and the team culture while delivering tools that become essential to how Appian supports thousands of mission-critical deployments worldwide.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and delivery of a scalable AI-powered triage platform that reduces mean time to resolution by leveraging AI agents, LangChain frameworks, and intelligent diagnostics
  • Lead the engineering team building AI-powered diagnostic tools that cut customer issue resolution time in half while scaling a platform that empowers support engineers across the globe.
  • Architect quarterly releases of diagnostic tools on AWS infrastructure, balancing innovation velocity with production stability and security requirements
  • Build and grow a high-performing engineering team through effective people management, technical mentorship, and career development focused on AI and cloud-native technologies
  • Partner with Customer Success and Product leadership to translate support pain points into engineering roadmaps that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction
  • Drive technical excellence through hands-on code reviews in Python and AI frameworks while establishing engineering best practices for the team
  • Execute stakeholder management across engineering, product, and customer-facing teams to align priorities and communicate progress on platform capabilities

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Hold a Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related STEM field
  • Experience: 8+ years of experience in software engineering with at least 2+ years in engineering management or technical leadership roles
  • AI Fluency: Proven fluency in AI and LLMs, encompassing both the strategic development of AI-powered platform capabilities and the hands-on application of AI tools to accelerate daily workflows
  • Python Expertise: Strong proficiency in Python with demonstrated experience building production-grade applications and diagnostic tools
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Hands-on experience designing and deploying scalable systems on AWS with knowledge of cloud-native architectures
  • AI Agent Development: Experience building AI agents and working with frameworks such as LangChain or similar orchestration tools
  • People Leadership: Proven track record managing engineering teams, including hiring, performance management, and technical mentorship
  • Technical Collaboration: Active participation in code reviews and ability to balance hands-on technical contributions with leadership responsibilities
  • Stakeholder Management: Strong communication skills with experience managing cross-functional stakeholders and translating business needs into technical solutions

Preferred Qualifications

  • Customer Support Domain: Experience building tools or platforms for customer support, site reliability, or operations teams
  • Diagnostic Systems: Background in observability, monitoring, troubleshooting tools, or root cause analysis platforms
  • Enterprise SaaS: Experience working in enterprise software companies with complex multi-tenant architectures
  • Ecosystem Experience: We value experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce or ServiceNow, as these skills translate well into our Enterprise-Grade Orchestration environment
